title: Authorization Journeys: Console Synthesis for Role Delegation, Cost Visibility, and Audit Playback
creator: Ava Chen
description: Synthesis design for a set of interconnected Console experiences: streamlined role delegation flows, combined org/workspace settings with cost context, and an 'audit playback' timeline that ties access changes to rollout events and cost anomalies. This ticket consolidates prior sketches and builds a cohesive interaction model and prototype for stakeholder review.
background: Multiple stakeholder interviews (support, security, platform teams) surfaced three pain points: 1) admins need to delegate temporary operational rights without creating permanent roles; 2) product and finance teams want immediate cost context when changing model/route rollouts; 3) audit logs are noisy and hard to correlate with rollout events and token cost spikes. Prior design notes exist but lack an integrated journey that connects role changes -> rollout actions -> audit artifacts and cost signal.
goals: Design a lightweight temporary-delegate flow (time-bound, scoped to routes) that surfaces least-privilege suggestions
Surface per-rollout cost estimates and historical cost deltas inline in rollout review screens
Create an audit 'playback' timeline that links access grants, API key usage, and rollout events with filters and jump-to-state
Produce an interactive prototype for validation with security and finance stakeholders
user_stories: As an org admin, I want to grant an engineer temporary access to update a rollout for 48 hours without creating a long-lived role so I can unblock an incident
As a product manager, I want to see an estimated monthly cost delta when I change a model variant in a canary so I can accept or postpone the rollout
As a security auditor, I want to replay the sequence of events that led to a permission escalation and view associated API keys and request traces
As a finance analyst, I want a per-workspace view of cost contributors tied to model family and rollout history
decisions: Use scoped temporary grants (subject, resource, actions, expiry) rather than ad-hoc admin notes
Show cost delta as a soft-warning chip in rollout modals and require explicit acknowledge for >10% change
Audit playback will be an executable timeline: each node links to the underlying audit log entry and any related trace/dashboard
tradeoffs: Inline cost estimates require a fast cost-read service; fallback will show cached estimates with a timestamp
Temporary scoped grants add UI complexity; mitigated with a compact default and an advanced editor for power users
Audit playback may surface sensitive metadata; sensitive fields will be obfuscated and require additional auth to reveal
review_comments: 2025-02-17 - Miguel Torres (Security): suggested adding a mandatory justification field for any delegate that includes 'write' capability
2025-02-21 - Hannah Lee (Finance): requested cost delta breakouts by model family and by tokens vs inference-hours
2025-02-25 - Tom Alvarez (Platform): flagged potential backend dependency on trace correlation (ENG-29002) and recommended a graceful degradation plan
2025-03-03 - Priya Nair (Design Review): prototype updated to include 'revoke' quick action in audit playback nodes; ready for stakeholder walkthrough
acceptance_criteria: Interactive Figma prototype demonstrates: create temporary delegate, perform a rollout with inline cost delta, and replay an audit timeline linking all three events
Design spec includes error states and fallback copy when cost estimates are unavailable
Security checklist included and sign-off from Security (ENG-SEC) recorded
Handoff package (tokens, components, accessibility notes) published in design system library
accessibility_notes: All interactive elements must meet WCAG 2.1 AA. Timeline nodes must be keyboard navigable and provide text alternatives for visual cues. Color usage for cost deltas must not rely solely on hue.
next_steps: Run 1-hour stakeholder walkthrough with Security, Finance, PM, and Eng (schedule week of 2025-03-10)
Create engineering tickets for backend cost API and trace correlation (ENG owners assigned)
Prepare design tokens and component variants for the Console DS
implementation_notes: Provide compact and expanded timeline modes. Use existing Audit API but add a thin correlation layer for rollout IDs. Cost estimate UI will accept an 'estimate_age' field and display stale tag if >15 minutes.
risks_mitigations: Risk: Overwhelming admins with too many options -> Mitigation: progressive disclosure and recommended presets
Risk: Cost estimates are inaccurate -> Mitigation: show confidence intervals and link to full cost dashboard
Risk: Audit playback exposes PII -> Mitigation: redact by default and require elevated permission to view sensitive fields
communication_plan: Post prototype and summary in #console-rbac Slack channel, invite stakeholders to a 45-minute demo, and attach Figma link and meeting notes to Confluence
